thread:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — Kapella hardware team wants a joint perf/W + throughput bench next Wed-Thu window. They asked for kernel-level tuning, telemetry export, and a short co-branded summary for the marketplace listing. Who can lead the kernel tune and smoke the pipeline?

Sasha: I can lead the kernel side. Need to know target models, sequence length distribution, and whether they want bf16 vs int8 baselines.

Devon: Happy to pair. Proposed baseline sweep: bf16 (single-socket), int8 quantized variant, and batched throughput runs. For kernel tuning we'll target IRQ affinity, PCIe ASPM off, and page-locking. We'll capture perf counters + power.

Amanda: From marketing: we need a short 1-paragraph co-branded blurb, 2 screenshots, and a 3-row metric table (watt/token, tokens/sec, delta vs baseline). Goal: publish with marketplace listing. Timeline: content final by Friday.

Raj: Telemetry plan: I'll run the collector stack (perf + nvml export + power probe). Need SSH to Kapella lab and an endpoint for our telemetry ingest. Also want KV-cache hit traces for long-form generation.

infra-bot: Reservation created: kapella-bench-pool reserved (8 GPUs) on 2026-03-31 08:00-18:00 UTC. Job slots: #9871-9878.

Morgan: @Sasha @Devon can you pair for a dry run on Monday? Prefer 14:00 UTC so marketing can see early results. :calendar: 

Sasha: Monday 14:00 UTC works. I'll assemble a checklist and share it in the runbook channel. Key items: kernel build variant names, sysctl tweaks, powercap values, and required firmware versions.

Devon: I'll prep `tune.sh` and a short config snippet. Example run command we'll use during smoke: ```bash
./tune.sh --model gpt-3-small --batch 8 --seq 1024 --powercap 250
``` Outputs: energy.csv, throughput.csv, dmesg.log, perf.raw.

Amanda: Please cc me on the runbook. Marketing also needs embargo guidance — is partner okay with 48h embargo?

tbarker: FYI — Kapella asked for an embargoed results window (48h) before any public announcement. They also requested we avoid naming internal kernel patches in the public blurb.

Morgan: Good call. Decision: if perf/W improvement < 5% we default to baseline for the marketplace claim (stability > marginal wins). Put that as a pass/fail gate in the runbook.

Sasha: Noted. I'll include a gating checklist with automated checks: 
- energy delta calc (watt/token)
- tokens/sec regression check
- kernel oops/dmesg scan

Raj: I'll hook telemetry endpoints to the run slots once infra provides SSH. Will also publish a sample telemetry dashboard link in the runbook.

Devon: Small note on measurement: synchronize clocks (`chrony`), pin processes to CPU list, and run multiple replicates (n=5) to smooth variance.

Amanda: Copying legal on the run artifacts requirement. We'll need logs + methodology for claims.

Morgan: Thanks everyone. I'll create the partner-facing agenda and share it with Kapella after Monday dry run. If anything blocks access to the lab, ping infra-bot here. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Dropping runbook link after I finish: /runbooks/kapella-kernel-tune.md (will paste Monday).

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run slot created 2026-03-30 14:00 UTC (3 hours).

tbarker: I'll coordinate the marketplace product listing slot with partner PMs; will confirm publish window after dry run.

Morgan: Great — meeting closed for now, follow-ups in the runbook thread.
